cases.query: How long after delivery can I request a refund?

retrieved.text:
Northstar Demo Store refund policy

Customers may request a refund within 30 calendar days after delivery. The item must be unused and returned with its receipt. Activated digital subscriptions are not refundable.

Northstar Demo Store shipping policy

Standard shipping usually takes 3 to 5 business days after dispatch. Customers can find the tracking link in the dispatch confirmation email. The store currently ships within the fictional Northstar region only.

Northstar Demo Store account security

Customers can enable two-step verification from Account Settings under Security. If a customer loses access to their verification device, they should contact support and provide the account email for identity verification. Support never asks customers to send their password.
